Easier first install: the app now tells you when Hermes Agent is missing and lets you add an AI key without a terminal.

## Install

Download **`Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.8.5.exe`** below and run it. It installs over 1.x and keeps your settings and chats. Check the download against **`SHA256SUMS.txt`** (PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.8.5.exe`).

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- No auto-update: install a newer `Hermes-Bots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.
- **Needs Hermes Agent v0.22.3 or newer.** Not installed yet? See *Step 0* in the README, or just open the app: it shows the one-line install command.

## New

- **"Hermes Agent isn't installed on this computer"** screen instead of `spawn hermes ENOENT`, with the install command for your system (copy button), a link to the install guide and **Retry**.
- **No AI provider yet?** A small notice says so and tells you to type `/login` in chat or run `hermes model` / `hermes setup` on the Hermes machine. The app doesn't ask for API keys; Hermes's own onboarding handles them.
- **Clearer SSH key errors:** picking a public key (`.pub`) says to choose the private key; a key file this Windows account can't read says so instead of "not found"; the permissions message says the owner must be your own account.

## Build and release

- Every release installer is now installed silently on a Windows runner and launched before it's published (smoke test), and the same check runs on pull requests.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` is attached to each release.
- CI installs from the frozen `bun.lock`. README now uses Bun commands.
- Demo data no longer contains personal paths.
